sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Fate handles liquid and settled debris
sections.text: Collection equipment will be arranged around the accessible release area and entry conditions. After pumping, settled solids and contaminated loose material still require removal. We will identify pools or waste beyond reach rather than treat a cleared entrance as evidence about the entire underside.

sections.title: Expose contact surfaces beneath disposable layers
sections.text: Specified insulation or damaged ground covering will be packaged and removed to reveal surfaces requiring treatment. We will physically remove soil and residue from reachable retained components, followed by appropriate disinfection. Affected soil, inaccessible joints or material that cannot be cleaned adequately will receive an explained further recommendation.

sections.title: Dry the retained structure before replacing coverings
sections.text: Moisture checks will guide drying of accessible joists and subfloor. We will distinguish those building components from the ground condition and report ongoing discharge requiring plumbing correction. Replacement layers should follow completed cleanup and moisture work instead of concealing contaminated or wet sections.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/fate.estimate: The proposal will describe liquid collection, solid waste handling and retained-surface treatment separately. Additional access and replacement construction will be identified where needed.
checklist: Share the location and status of the drain repair.
Describe material already pumped or removed.
Identify all usable crawl-space entrances.
